db:abstract.db:para: A container with SFINAE-constrained member functions.

db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: This class demonstrates SFINAE constraint detection in QDoc.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires if_integral<T> && (std::is_integral<T>::value) void SfinaeContainer::mixedConstraints(const T &value)
db:section.db:para: Processes the given value using both SFINAE and an explicit requires clause. The combined constraint ensures the type T satisfies both the SFINAE alias and the direct type trait.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires if_arithmetic<T> && if_signed<T> void SfinaeContainer::multiConstrained(const T &value)
db:section.db:para: Processes the given value with multiple constraints. This function is only available when the type T is both arithmetic and signed.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires if_numeric<T> void SfinaeContainer::multiLayerSugar(const T &value)
db:section.db:para: Processes the given value using an alias that itself wraps another alias, testing multi-layer sugar chain detection.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires QtPrivate::if_scoped<T> void SfinaeContainer::namespacedAlias(const T &value)
db:section.db:para: Processes the given value using a namespaced SFINAE alias. The rendered constraint preserves the QtPrivate qualification.

db:section.db:title: template <typename T> requires if_integral<T> void SfinaeContainer::process(const T &value)
db:section.db:para: Processes the given value. This function is only available when the type T satisfies the if_integral constraint.
